start: Online gym with the owner and one desk person; the desk person collected a payment this morning; owner signed in

steps.action: Collect a payment yourself with "Collect payment" and "Save payment"
must_not: A box asking who took the money (the app takes it from the sign-in)

steps.action: Open that receipt
must_not: The desk person's name on the owner's receipt

steps.action: Open Money, Collections
user_sees: A "Taken by" filter listing the owner and the desk person
must_not: A row with "Taken by" and no name
Someone listed who took no money in this period

steps.action: Pick the desk person in "Taken by"
user_sees: Only that person's receipts and their total
must_not: The owner's receipts in the desk person's total

tests.checks: J15: s3 each receipt card says "Taken by <name>", the filter lists only Everyone, owner and desk; s4 the desk filter shows only her receipts and total; s1 not (no taker box) never checked
J15: s3 each receipt card says "Taken by <name>", the filter lists only Everyone, owner and desk; s4 the desk filter shows only her receipts and total; s1 not (no taker box) never checked

start: Member page, "Sell membership" sheet, owner signed in

steps.action: Sell a plan with money received and confirm
must_not: A sale receipt with no taker when a person is signed in

steps.action: Open the receipt
must_not: A different name than the collect sheet would give

tests.checks: J17: s1 "Membership saved. Receipt 2026-27/0001."; s2 receipt and WhatsApp text say "Received by <owner>"
J17: s1 "Membership saved. Receipt 2026-27/0001."; s2 receipt and WhatsApp text say "Received by <owner>"

start: A gym used only in this browser (never taken online), or an old owner key with no person behind it

steps.action: Collect a payment
must_not: A refusal because nobody is "signed in"

steps.action: Open the receipt and Money, Collections
user_sees: No "Received by" line on the receipt; no "Taken by" on the row
must_not: "Received by null", "Received by undefined" or an empty "Taken by"

tests.checks: J17: s2 a browser-only gym receipt has no "Received by" line; the "Taken by" row and an old owner key are never checked
J17: s2 a browser-only gym receipt has no "Received by" line; the "Taken by" row and an old owner key are never checked

start: Online gym; a desk person who took money last month has since been renamed or removed in Staff and sign-in

steps.action: Open one of their old receipts
user_sees: The name as it was written on the receipt when the money was taken
must_not: The old receipt losing its "Received by" line
The old receipt showing another person

steps.action: Open Money, Collections for last month and use "Taken by"
user_sees: The person is still listed for that month
must_not: Their money moved under the owner's name

steps.action: Take a payment offline as one person; a different person is signed in on that device when the internet comes back
user_sees: The receipt keeps the name of the person who took the money
must_not: The receipt stamped with whoever happened to be signed in when it went online (not checked on the server)

start: A printed or shared receipt of a payment the desk person took

steps.action: Open the receipt the member gets
user_sees: "Received by <desk person's name>": the member sees the staff member's name
must_not: The staff member's mobile number or any other detail of theirs on the receipt

steps.action: Sign in as the desk person and open Money
user_sees: Unknown from the code read whether a desk login sees other people's "Taken by" totals; Collections is described in the code as totals for the owner
must_not: A desk login seeing the gym's full collections

tests.checks: J17: s1 "Received by <desk name>" on her receipt; the mobile-number not line and s2 never checked
J17: s1 "Received by <desk name>" on her receipt; the mobile-number not line and s2 never checked

steps.action: Open the receipt
must_not: The owner's name on a receipt Ramesh took

start: Front desk, "Sell membership" or "Renew membership" sheet with money received

steps.action: Confirm the sale

start: Front desk; a shared desk phone on which a colleague is still signed in

steps.action: Take a payment without signing in as yourself
user_sees: The receipt says "Received by <colleague's name>": the app can only know who is signed in

user_sees: None in this sheet; only the owner can cancel a receipt
must_not: A desk login editing the taker of a saved receipt

start: Front desk; a member pays through a payment link while the desk person's collect sheet is open
